title: Why 2021-cohort firms have no usable observation, 2019-2024
question: Which loss dominates in each cash-moderator cohort before and after 2021: a missing required line or an absent original statement?
notes_text: Source: RFSD v3.1.0; saved Task 5 cohort observation accounting for the four outcome cohorts with the cash moderator. Each bar stacks the firms of the fixed 2021 baseline cohort that lack a comparable usable observation in that financial year, divided by the cohort size, by exhaustive reason; the remainder is usable. 2021 is 100 percent usable by construction. Years before 2021 are backward observation of a cohort defined in 2021, not survival. No original statement is not evidence of non-submission or concealment. The four cohorts overlap and must not be summed. The appendix tabulates these counts; this is their picture.
reading: Borrowing loses most of its cohort to a missing debt line, cash to an absent original; the picture the appendix tables hold.
